cases.title: Regional Fintech App Expansion into SEE Markets
cases.summary: Technical and operational readiness for launching a financial app in new SEE markets.
cases.problem: Expanding the app into new SEE markets meant meeting central bank and financial regulatory requirements in each jurisdiction, while steering committees, partner banks, legal teams and vendors all had to stay in sync.
cases.approach: Directed technical and operational readiness for the regional expansion and coordinated compliance requirements under central bank and financial regulatory frameworks. Ran regular alignment between steering committees, partner banking PMs and legal teams to keep milestones synchronized across jurisdictions, and coordinated external vendors, localized third-party integrations and security audit workflows.
my_role: Technical and operational readiness across target markets
Compliance coordination under central bank and financial regulation
Alignment of steering committees, partner banking PMs and legal teams
Vendor, third-party integration and security audit coordination
cases.outcome: Focused on pre-launch optimization and go-live readiness, aimed at expanding the client's market presence.
context_points: Fintech app, regional rollout into SEE markets
Partner banks and regulators in several jurisdictions

cases.title: B2C Webshop for Slovenia
cases.summary: Localized launch with market-specific requirements, QA, and readiness gates.
cases.impact: Delivered 100% on schedule with zero critical go-live blockers.
cases.problem: Localization requires alignment with market rules, legal constraints, and technical requirements.
cases.approach: Coordinated end-to-end delivery of the localized webshop across business, legal, and technical workstreams. Translated requirements into stories, managed sprints, coordinated teams, and drove UAT and go-live readiness.
my_role: Sprint planning, reporting, and scope control
cases.outcome: The webshop launched on schedule, with business, legal and technical workstreams aligned and no critical blockers at go-live.

cases.title: UNIQA Integration: Automated Warranty Policy Generation
cases.summary: Automation and workflow design connecting webshop and insurer systems.
cases.impact: Reduced warranty processing time by over 70%.
cases.problem: Warranty policy generation had too many manual steps, slowing processing and increasing operational cost.
cases.approach: Designed the detailed logic, workflows, and data mapping for the integration between eKupi and UNIQA insurance systems. Aligned stakeholders and coordinated implementation, testing, deployment, and monitoring.
my_role: Logic, workflow and data mapping design
cases.outcome: Automation streamlined post-sale operations, reducing manual work and improving turnaround time for warranty processing.
context_points: Integration between the eKupi webshop and UNIQA insurance systems
results: Warranty processing time reduced by over 70%

cases.title: Home of Brands: Multi-Brand Regional E-commerce Platform
cases.summary: One regional storefront bringing six consumer brands together across CEE/SEE markets.
cases.problem: Home of Brands (HOB) wanted its consumer brand portfolios unified into a single, seamless regional storefront, with payment, tax and compliance working correctly in every target market.
cases.approach: Led end-to-end delivery of the multi-brand B2C platform. Directed platform architecture, UI/UX design workflows and backend development teams to ensure localized payment, tax and regional compliance across target CEE/SEE markets, and managed third-party vendors, system integrations and sprint cycles.
my_role: Direction of architecture, UI/UX and backend teams
Third-party vendor and system integration management
cases.outcome: A unified multi-brand storefront for the region, with localized payment, tax and compliance and a faster path to market.
context_points: Brands: Delimano, Rovus, Wellneo, Schmidler, Walkmaxx, WATA

cases.title: Abrakadabra Mobile App Delivery
cases.summary: Agile delivery with stakeholder alignment and fast response to change.
cases.impact: Improved user satisfaction by 15% upon release.
cases.problem: Multiple stakeholders and shifting priorities required steady delivery without losing scope clarity.
cases.approach: Organized Agile ceremonies and drove requirements gathering together with stakeholders. Prioritized the backlog, clarified requirements quickly, and handled change requests promptly to avoid delays while meeting core business requirements.
cases.outcome: Delivered within scope with improved user perception after release.
context_points: Alongside the app, owned the department's technology strategy and budget for B2C e-commerce, reporting metrics and risks to senior leadership
Mentored engineers through training workshops and best-practice documentation

cases.title: Dropshipping + Logistics Integrations
cases.summary: Multi-partner delivery setup with dependencies across carriers and suppliers.
cases.problem: Delivery operations needed faster fulfillment and consistent handoffs across multiple partners.
cases.approach: Integrated dropshipping with TISAK and coordinated multiple logistics partners to streamline flows and reduce friction.
cases.outcome: More predictable delivery and faster order handoffs across the network.

cases.title: eKupi Migration to SAP eCommerce Platform
cases.summary: Multi-market migration with data integrity, configuration, and enablement.
cases.impact: Webshops in 5 markets migrated to SAP eCommerce without data loss.
cases.problem: Several regional webshops needed platform migration while protecting data integrity and minimizing disruption.
cases.approach: Led the multi-regional migration of eKupi's webshops to the SAP eCommerce platform. Coordinated migration work, validated product and content data, configured payment methods, delivery options and product displays, and supported teams with documentation.
my_role: Migration validation and content integrity checks
Site configuration: payments, delivery options, product displays
Training and documentation through internal portal
cases.outcome: Modernized platform foundation across markets and improved operational consistency.
context_points: Markets: Croatia, Serbia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, North Macedonia
results: Products and content moved without data loss, including images, descriptions and pricing
